stepBody:
Justin fits a different classification model on the training data. He applies this model to a test set and gets the following results, one bullet per test point:
• true label $$1$$, prediction $$1$$, outputted probability of $$y=1$$ equal to $$0.88$$
• true label $$1$$, prediction $$0$$, outputted probability of $$y=1$$ equal to $$0.4$$
• true label $$1$$, prediction $$1$$, outputted probability of $$y=1$$ equal to $$0.75$$
• true label $$0$$, prediction $$0$$, outputted probability of $$y=1$$ equal to $$0.3$$
• true label $$0$$, prediction $$0$$, outputted probability of $$y=1$$ equal to $$0.54$$
Calculate the recall of the model on the test set. You do not need to simplify algebra.
